Items are [nonnegative weight, nonnegative value]. Given nonnegative integer capacity, return the greatest attainable value when each item may be selected at most once. Zero-weight items are allowed.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    [
      [
        2,
        6
      ],
      [
        3,
        10
      ],
      [
        4,
        12
      ]
    ],
    5
  ],
  "expected": 16
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    [
      [
        0,
        5
      ],
      [
        1,
        2
      ]
    ],
    0
  ],
  "expected": 5
}
Hint

Update capacities backward so an item is not reused.

Complexity: O(n*(capacity+1)) time, O(capacity+1) space
